blocks.text: As a doctor, I’ve become very good at telling people to take care of their health. Eat less salt. Avoid too much sugar. Exercise. Stop smoking. Have your blood pressure checked. But after years of saying these things, I’ve also started asking a harder question: What happens when people know what they should do, but […]...
